body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcV2ijbfB8Drvs2oik6
Part of #27377 (wave 3, W3-C1)

Release-candidate run of the standing smoke (`priority:P0`) for 18.3.0. Every one of the 23 runnable items has a verdict: **20 PASS, 3 PARTIAL, 0 FAIL, 0 BLOCKED, 0 NOT-RUN**. No item reported a clause failure. The three partials each come from one blocked clause that the item's own `fixtures.knownGaps` predicts. The off-clause probes produced four low-severity product cards (extracted, see the close-out comment) and two security findings, detail withheld and fix dispatched (see "Off-clause probes").

## Environment fingerprint
- Framework `c4c515ad3cc342043a2b81b5a06a5793f79a23e8` (detached checkout, `git status` clean before and after the run), including `ui/`. The Console was built in-repo from the same commit: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (12m43s, exit 0), then `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` (exit 0). `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` was green (105 artifacts).
- Stale-console-bundle ruled out: every boot served `/_console/` entry `assets/index-DkXHr74P.js`, the same file as `packages/console/dist/assets`. The dispatcher checked this once and each browser runner re-checked it on its own boot.
- Node 22.22.0, pnpm 10.31.0, Playwright chromium build 1243 (matches `/opt/pw-browsers`; launched without the `executablePath` override).
- App: `examples/app-showcase`. One `os dev` compile boot by the dispatcher wrote `dist/objectstack.json`. Every runner boot afterwards used `--no-compile` (from the tree, or from a scratch copy outside the tree with `node_modules` symlinked), so concurrent boots never rewrote the shared artifact.
- Boot line: `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads setsid pnpm -C … exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile -p PORT -d file:RUN/ITEM.db`, with `--fresh` / `--log-level info` where an item asked for them. Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai) plus the showcase seed (132 rows / 19 datasets, measured).
- Ports: 41101–41109 (R1), 41201–41209 (R2), 41301–41309 (R3), 41401–41409 (R4), 41501–41509 (R5), 41601–41609 (R6), 41701–41709 (R7), 41001 and 41010 (dispatcher). Each item ran on its own file DB under its runner's scratch dir.
- Walled leg: `os dev` with `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`. The banner read `Tenancy: isolated`, not degraded.
- The v17-shaped DB came from npm `@objectstack/cli@17.7.0 --legacy-peer-deps`, from a blank-scaffold `os dev` boot, because no 17.x showcase is published. The 18.0 pre-release DB is the `cli-18-prerelease-db` restore. Copies only, with a checksum or row diff around every step.
- Timestamps: prep 04:19Z–04:32Z, runners 04:34Z–05:14Z, 2026-10-29.

## Execution
Parallel, per SKILL §2. Seven runner subagents (R1–R7), each with its own port range and file DBs. API and CLI items fanned out; browser items ran at most three at a time (R5, R6, R7, one browser each). The dispatcher checked every runner's verdicts against the raw evidence it captured (pin outputs, HTTP traces, boot logs), and independently reproduced the off-clause security probes on its own boot (port 41010, twice) before dispatching anything. Container memory stayed under 11 GiB throughout.
